acceptance_criteria: Access mutation and durable replay-work creation commit atomically.
A replay admission failure cannot return an unqualified success response.
A failed message remains retryable and is never marked complete before durable admission.
Restart resumes pending replay work idempotently without replaying completed messages.
Partial completion and unreadable queue state are explicit, bounded, and privacy-safe.
blast_radius: Newly approved direct-message senders, access state, replay ordering and deduplication, restart recovery, API truth, and operator diagnostics.
evidence_summary: Three stable live reads pinned the open issue identity, P4 label, update time, URL, and exact body hash while SSH remote main remained at de3f69bbb5648b804ea2843d310c47dda544a056. The prior and current main revisions have no changes in any decisive or affected path. Exact-main source still persists access before invoking replay, catches replay failure, and returns HTTP success; the replay loop records each message ID before awaiting runtime admission. A 29-assertion exact-main source falsifier passed. Fourteen focused supporting suites passed 559 of 559 tests, including the route behavior that intentionally keeps HTTP 200 after callback rejection; because the audit branch differs from main in shared runtime/database paths, those executions are supporting characterization rather than exact-main runtime proof. A fully paginated stable-main capture covered 36 open pull requests, 28 drafts, 40 changed-file pages, and 1,276 file occurrences with zero declared-count mismatch. It found no direct issue reference or implementation owner; draft PR #2451 is taxonomy-only partial coordination and the remaining open overlaps are path collisions. Merged PR #741 is a valid partial historical implementation.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if access and replay work committed atomically, callback failure produced a non-success or explicit partial disposition, or replay completion followed durable admission. Exact-main source disproves all three. Exact-main fault-injected transaction and restart execution and production incidence measurement remain implementation-time obligations.
impact: Access can be durably allowed and reported successful after replay fails, while the failed message is pre-marked complete and may be excluded from retry.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2548 and remote main immediately before integration; reject changed identity, labels, timestamp, URL, or body hash.
Reconfirm every decisive and affected path byte at the pinned revision.
Specify replay-work identity, transaction boundary, retry authority, and partial-completion schema before implementation.
Re-scan every open pull request and retain one implementation owner while coordinating taxonomy with PR #2451.
Add RED and GREEN tests for rollback, callback failure, partial completion, duplicate allow, restart resume, and privacy-safe diagnostics.
Run the decisive suites against committed implementation bytes.
